The '''Stobar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Boeus sector/Legends|Boeus sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]]. The system was famous for its crime and violence.
